import Analysis.Complex.Log
import Tactic.Basic

open Complex

theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {f : ι → ℂ} (hf : Summable f) : Summable fun i => log (1 + f i) := by
  let ε := 1 / 2
  have h1 : ∀ i, |f i| < 1 ∨ |f i| ≥ 1 := by intro i; cases le_total |f i| 1
  have h2 : ∀ i, |f i| < 1 → Re (1 + f i) > 0 := by
    intro i; intro h; rw [add_re]; exact lt_trans (lt_add_right (Re 1) (Re (f i))) (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_refl (Re 1)) h)
  have h3 : ∀ i, |log (1 + f i)| ≤ 2 * |f i| := by
    intro i; obtain ⟨h, _⟩ := h1 i;
    split_ifs with h1;
    · refine' (log_abs_bound (1 + f i) (abs_pos (Re (1 + f i)))).trans _
      exact le_rfl
    · refine' (log_abs_bound (1 + f i) (abs_pos (Re (1 + f i)))).trans _
      exact le_rfl
  have h4 : Summable (fun i => |f i|) := by apply summable_abs; exact hf
  have h5 : Summable (fun i => 2 * |f i|) := by apply summable_mul_const; exact h4
  exact summable_of_le h5 (fun i => le_rfl)
